summary.text: Jeff Steinborn is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2017, representing District 36 in Doña Ana County.
The legislature's member page lists Steinborn as a representative from 2007 to 2010 and from 2013 to 2016, and as a member of the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Steinborn's occupation as land conservation and a district office in Las Cruces.
Between sessions, Steinborn chairs the Radioactive and Hazardous Materials Committee and is a member of the Water and Natural Resources Committee.
